data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 网球训练场
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 网球训练场】午后明亮的网球场上，结衣穿着清爽的网球运动装，握着球拍稍作休息。她擦去额头的汗珠，团子发髻被微风轻轻拂动，转头露出灿烂的笑容——「刚才那一球我可是用了全力哦！休息一下，再来一局吧。」
data.action: 握着网球拍在场边擦汗，笑着准备下一局
data.promptProse: At the school court's edge, Yui holds her tennis racket in one hand and wipes a bead of sweat with the other, grinning before the next game. Sleeveless athletic top, white pleated tennis skirt and sneakers retain the sporting outfit. The medium view includes the net and painted court lines receding behind her. Afternoon sunlight brightens racket strings and her cheek, casting a clear racket shadow across the court beside her.
